# QT Imaging Announces CPT® Category III Code for 3D Breast Acoustic Imaging Now Effective


October 01, 2026 8:30am EDT


*Code 1079T is effective as of October 1, 2026, three months earlier than anticipated*


NOVATO, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[QT Imaging Holdings, Inc.](http://www.qtimaging.com/) **(Nasdaq: QTI) (“QT Imaging” or the “Company”),** a medical device company dedicated to transforming breast health management through innovative, radiation-free imaging technology, today announced that CPT® Category III code 1079T for 3D quantitative transmission water bath volumetric ultrasound tomography of the breast is effective for dates of service beginning October 1, 2026. The code is effective for use three months earlier than the Company had previously anticipated.


The earlier effective date allows healthcare providers to begin using a dedicated CPT code to report this breast imaging service and enables QT Imaging to immediately advance implementation efforts with imaging centers, physicians, and payers.


The code specifically describes, “3D quantitative transmission water bath volumetric ultrasound tomography, breast, with augmentative algorithmic derivation of breast tissue composition (i.e., fibroglandular volume), bilateral, with physician or other qualified health care professional interpretation and report.” The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services’ October 2026 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule Database update identifies 1079T as a new code with an October 1, 2026, record effective date.


“The October 1 effective date is an important milestone in expanding access to QT Imaging’s technology,” said Dr. Raluca Dinu, Chief Executive Officer of QT Imaging. “Providers now have a dedicated CPT code to report this type of breast imaging service, three months earlier than we had anticipated. This allows us to begin working immediately with imaging centers, physicians, and payers on implementation as we continue building the reimbursement infrastructure needed to support broader commercial adoption of our QTI Breast Acoustic CT™ Scanner and QTI Precision Pathway™ cloud platform.”


**About QT Imaging**


QT Imaging Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: QTI) is a medical device company engaged in the research, development, and commercialization of innovative imaging systems that use low-frequency sound waves. QT Imaging Holdings, Inc. strives to improve global health outcomes. Its strategy is predicated upon the fact that medical imaging is critical to the detection, diagnosis, and treatment of disease and that it should be safe, affordable, accessible, and centered on the patient’s experience.
